research:
I found no resolving information. As of 2026-08-13, META's last confirmed close is **$578.85 on 2026-08-12**. The stock is about 18% below a ~$750 consensus target and still under pressure after a weak Q2 report on July 29. The resolution date is 20 trading days out.

## 1. Resolution source
- Source: the Yahoo Finance daily close for META on 2026-09-10, a Thursday and a normal trading day. The Yahoo history page refused my direct connection, so the values below come from search excerpts of Yahoo's history table and StockAnalysis. [Yahoo history](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/META/history/)
- 2026-08-12: close $578.85 (open 601.07, high 604.50, low 578.21), down 3.38%. I found no news explaining the drop. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/meta/history/)
- 2026-08-11: close $599.12 (high 612.43, low 593.40). [Yahoo history](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/META/history)
- 2026-08-10: close $594.92. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/meta/history/)
- The 2026-08-13 close was not available when forecasts close (18:00 UTC, before the market closes).

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The price is ~$579, in the lower-middle of the question's $300-800 range.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-13: 24/7 Wall St quotes the stock at $578.85 against an average analyst target of $754.14. Rosenblatt has the Street-high target, $1,117. [247wallst](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/13/meta-remains-a-deeply-discounted-giant-wall-street-expects-30-gains-one-analyst-expects-100/?.tsrc=rss)
- 2026-08-03: Benzinga, cited in a search summary, reported a rebound of nearly 7% that Monday. [Leverage Shares](https://leverageshares.com/en-eu/insights/meta-q2-2026-earnings-ai-capex-turns-market-sentiment/)
- 2026-07-31: Polymarket's page says META closed near $557. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/meta-above-in-august-2026)
- 2026-07-30: Shares fell about 9-10% on the Q2 report, about $531 premarket from a $585.61 prior close. Several outlets called it the stock's worst day of the year. [Finbold](https://finbold.com/meta-stock-plunges-9-overnight-heres-why/), [finanzen.at](https://www.finanzen.at/nachrichten/aktien/why-meta-platforms-stock-fell-10percent-today-15835132)
- 2026-07-30: Analysts cut targets. HSBC went from $905 to $830, KeyBanc from $790 to $780 (Overweight), and Wedbush from $671 to $595 (Neutral). [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3555038/meta-platforms-meta-analysts-cut-price-targets-after-q2-miss), [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/meta-platforms-nasdaqmeta-price-target-cut-to-78000-by-analysts-at-keycorp-2026-07-30/)
- 2026-07-29: Q2 results:
  - Revenue was $60.8B, up 28%, ahead of the ~$60.2B estimate.
  - EPS was $6.18 against roughly $7.14-7.22 expected. It included $2.4B in legal charges and $1.2B in severance.
  - Free cash flow fell to $784M from $8.5B a year earlier.
  - Capex guidance for 2026 is now $130-145B.
  - Q3 revenue guidance is $61-64B, slightly below consensus at the midpoint.

  [HL](https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/company--news/meta-shares-tumble-as-free-cash-flow-nosedives), [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/meta-stock-slips-more-than-6-after-hours-on-raised-capital-expenditure-guidance-4646698)
- 2026-07-29: Shares had fallen nine sessions in a row before earnings. [Mitrade](https://www.mitrade.com/au/insights/news/live-news/article-8-1943342-20260729)
- 2026-06-05: The FT reported that Meta was weighing a stock sale worth billions to fund AI. Meta called it "pure speculation", and the stock fell about 5.5% to ~$593. This overhang is unresolved as of mid-August. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/06/08/meta-is-reportedly-weighing-a-multibillion-dollar/), [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/meta-stock-drops-capital-raising-speculation/)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- Recent range: about $531-612 over the two weeks since earnings. The stock was about $585-593 in June and late July.
- Recent single-day moves: -3.4% (Aug 12), about +7% (Aug 3), about -10% (Jul 30), -5.5% (Jun 5).
- My rough estimate, not a sourced figure: META has usually traded at roughly 35-45% annualized volatility. That implies a one-standard-deviation move of about 10-12% over 20 trading days, or about ±$60-70 from $579. A one-sigma band would be about $510-650. Moves of over 20% in a month without earnings are uncommon but have happened, for example after news of an equity raise.
- I could not get current options-implied volatility.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs a "Meta above ___ in August 2026" market. I could not load its prices. I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market specifically for September 10. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/meta-above-in-august-2026)
- Analysts: consensus target about $754 per 24/7 Wall St, with Wedbush low at $595 and Rosenblatt high at $1,117. These are 12-month targets, not one-month forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before Sep 10
- Late August (my assumption, no source checked):
  - The Jackson Hole Fed symposium.
  - Nvidia's quarterly earnings, which usually move AI and capex names.
- Early September: the August jobs report (~Sep 4). August CPI may come out around Sep 10-11. The FOMC meets in mid-to-late September, after resolution.
- Any time: a Meta equity offering (the FT's June report remains unconfirmed), more legal rulings (Q2 already carried $2.4B in legal charges), or AI and capex news.
- After resolution, so not directly relevant: Meta Connect on Sept 23-24, 2026. Anticipation of it could still matter. [Road to VR](https://roadtovr.com/meta-connect-2026-date-announcement/)
- No Meta earnings fall before Sep 10. Q3 results are expected in late October.
